name: mend-finalize
description: Phase 2 of the crane Mend flow — after the crane PR merges to the integration branch and the CI build completes, fetches the real semantic version, updates HarborVersionsSettings.php in the a.blazemeter.com branch from latest-<branch> to the real version, opens the a.blazemeter.com PR into develop, and updates the MOB ticket. Triggered by /orch run mend-finalize --target <component> --scope <fix-branch>,<MOB-ticket>.
